hooks.command: { [ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ] && d=$(jq -r ".cwd // empty") && tmux rename-window -t "$TMUX_PANE" "🚀 $(basename "${d:-$PWD}")" && tmux set-option -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude_state "🚀"; } 2>/dev/null || true
{ [ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ] && d=$(jq -r ".cwd // empty") && tmux rename-window -t "$TMUX_PANE" "⏳ $(basename "${d:-$PWD}")" && tmux set-option -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude_state "⏳"; } 2>/dev/null || true
{ [ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ] && d=$(jq -r ".cwd // empty") && tmux rename-window -t "$TMUX_PANE" "✅ $(basename "${d:-$PWD}")" && tmux set-option -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude_state "✅"; } 2>/dev/null || true
{ [ -n "$TMUX_PANE" ] && d=$(jq -r ".cwd // empty") && tmux rename-window -t "$TMUX_PANE" "💬 $(basename "${d:-$PWD}")" && tmux set-option -t "$TMUX_PANE" @claude_state "💬"; } 2>/dev/null || true

c=$(jq -r '.tool_input.command // empty'); if printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qE 'gh +pr +(create|edit)' && printf '%s' "$c" | grep -qiE 'claude\.ai/code|Claude-Session:'; then echo 'Remove the Claude session link from the PR description (no agent attribution).' >&2; exit 2; fi
